rows.name:
A huge herd of herbivores has appeared in Gula,
mo! They are unusually ferocious, mo! Defeat
them before Torigo is harmed, mo!

Torigo's fields are being ravaged, mo. Defeat
the culprits before everyone goes hungry, mo!

Imperial rank-and-file usually get beaten. But
even they dream of being the strongest, mo...
This time, they are serious opponents, mo!

In every age, pests swarm to beautiful things,
mo. Beat them quickly or more will keep
appearing, so fight carefully, mo!

Flying monsters are blackening the sky, mo.
Knock them down, and you should manage... or so
the Nopon Great Sage thinks, mo.

Your goal is to smash the totem the Tirkin
worship like a sacred tree, mo. Show no mercy,
mo. Believers keep gathering. I am jealous, mo.

This challenge takes a little thinking, mo. It
is easy for the Nopon Great Sage, but how about
you, mo?

No matter how many times I see it, the end of
civilization is sad, mo. It is time to return
these transformed lives to the earth, mo.

Diburo have appeared at Iyasaki Village's Cloud
Sea bath, mo. Restore peace to the beach, mo.
Rumor says the red Diburo are perverts, mo.

This is the real-life version of TIGER! TIGER!,
mo. You do not get an experience like this
often, mo. Go, Tora! You are the chosen one,
mo!

Special training with the Nopon Great Sage's
power, mo! Rematch the Iira Drivers who gave
you trouble, mo. I expect victory, mo!

A serious match between men using their full
power. That is what the Nopon Great Sage wants
to see, mo. Do not let your guard down, mo.

Dinosaurs are big, mo. Dinosaurs are strong,
mo. How strong would a whole group of them be,
mo? ...But the small hanger-on is most
dangerous, mo.

The Tirkin, Igna, and Garlus tribes have joined
forces and are after you, mo. This will decide
which side has the stronger bond, mo!

A challenge letter has arrived from monsters,
mo! Fugitive Warrior Darkrod appears with
allies, mo. Nothing is scarier than a fugitive
counterattack, mo!

You have incurred the Cloud Sea King's wrath,
mo. He nearly turned red with rage, mo.
Colossal's counterattack begins: a fierce
battle, mo!

Territorial Barbarossa and Immovable Gonzalez
are famous veteran Gogols, but these turbulent
times have finally produced a new hero, mo...

Once born, a superintelligence leaves its
creator behind and never stops evolving, mo.
You will experience that terror firsthand, mo.

The martial way is the relentless pursuit of
strength, mo. There are as many schools as
stars, but today the strongest will be decided,
mo!

The 9th Armored Division is the Empire's
strongest... They now deploy a forbidden Divine
Beast weapon, mo. A harsh battle awaits, mo...
I am getting excited, mo...

This challenge is what is called a score
attack, mo. Do not just defeat the monsters
that appear; think about how to earn score as
you fight, mo.

In this challenge, you will have Angu grow, mo.
Keep it on the edge of life and death, like
some ruler, and keep fighting it skillfully,
mo.

Shin took down a Divine Beast battleship alone.
With the Nopon Great Sage's power, you can
relive that battle, mo. It is chilling, mo!

At last, the time has come again, mo! Today we
decide this year's Nopon Hero, mo! Some very
quirky challengers await Tora, mo!

From a world different from Alst, a ferocious
warrior has come alone, mo! It is time to rise
and defend Alst, mo!

Let bygones be bygones, mo! Enjoy the simulated
battle with Elma arranged by the Nopon Great
Sage, mo!

A sudden poison monster turned a Liberalitas
spring into a poison bog, mo. With a special
combat suit for poison bogs, there is nothing
to fear, mo!

Challenge available from chapter 6.
Requires the "Nopon Challenge Letter, Pt. 2"
key item.

Challenge available after completing
main story.

Challenge available after completing
stage 5 in TIGER! TIGER!.

Challenge available after defeating
certain Unique Monster.

Rex, Nia, Tora, Meleph, Zeke,
Homura, Byakko, Hana JS, Kagutsuchi,
Saika, Shulk and Fiorung required.
Blades must be engaged.
